calculationMethod: Class I water minimum through 3,000 gallons plus the next 3,000 at $6.70 per 1,000 and quantities over 6,000 at $7.25 per 1,000. Sewer minimum through 3,000 plus $6.38 per 1,000 beyond it. Interactive examples use whole 1,000-gallon increments; actual billing rounding is not established.
geography: Navarre Beach utility service and leasehold documents; do not apply these rates to all mainland Navarre addresses
evidenceType: Published official schedule and document requirements, not observed household bills or property-specific quotes

water.class: Class I: single family or individually metered multifamily, per unit each month

illustrationLimits: Calculated from the Class I schedule only. Not a customer's bill. Excludes other services, fees, taxes, deposits and connection charges. Confirm class, service and actual account billing with the utility. Shared-meter condominium treatment can differ.

lease.status: County amendment process, not proof that every parcel has an executed amendment

tax.status: The appraiser page says 2026 final millage is unavailable until October 2026; estimates based on 2025 rates remain estimates. Non-ad-valorem amounts vary by parcel.

routeEvidence.method: Record exact origin, authorized entrance and work destination, provider, date, departure period, direction, distance, estimate, toll treatment and gate-processing exclusions. Keep driven observations separate.
routeEvidence.status: Method documented; no timed drive or address-specific travel-time observation claimed
